描述_ZN: The Gurkha Envoy to the Capital" from the booklet "The Battle of Pingxing Gurkha", Qianlong, Qing dynasty, painted by an unknown artist, on paper with color, 55.3 cm long and 91.4 cm wide.　　The upper part of the painting is inscribed by the Qianlong emperor with the poem "Gorkha Accompanying the Minister to the Capital", with the following inscription: "The imperial pen of the new Zheng in the year sebu." Inscriptions of two square seals in vermilion, "Eight symbols of the old and the old" and "Self-consciousness", and a round seal in white, "Appreciated by Qianlong". At the beginning of the quote, it is inscribed with a square seal in vermilion, "The Treasure of the Emperor", and the seal of the Qing government, "Sanxitang Jingjian Seal", in vermilion, and the seal of "Yizi Sun" in white. The year "kecu" is the fifty-eighth year of the Qianlong era (1793), when the Qianlong Emperor was 83 years old.　　In front of the Purple Pavilion, a treasure tent was set up, and the envoys from Gorkha were already kneeling on the ground, awaiting the arrival of the Qianlong Emperor. The Qianlong emperor arrived in a step carriage under the eyes of all the people, showing his supreme style.　　Gorkha (now Nepal) is located in the southwest of China's Tibet, and its territory is intertwined with Tibet. In 1788, the Gurkha invaded Tibet, and the court was concealed by Bazhong, the minister of the court of justice, who agreed to a contract between the Tibetan Kailong and the Gurkha for the withdrawal of troops and payment. Three years later, on the pretext that the debt had not been cleared, the Gurkha again sent troops to Tibet, and this time they were beaten by the Qing army, and the battle became the last of the Qianlong Emperor's "Ten Great Military Achievements". The Qianlong emperor ordered the court painter to create a booklet of the "Battle of the Gurkha" in recognition of the generals of the expedition from the 56th to the 57th year of the Qianlong era (1792-1793), and to promote the military achievements of the Qianlong dynasty.　　This album has 8 pages, showing the major battles such as the "Attack on Ermu" and the "Attack on Magar Jirga" and the "Gorkha Envoys to the Capital" in which the Qianlong Emperor received the Gorkha envoys in the Ziguang Pavilion. ". Since the contents depicted in each picture are based on historical facts, they are of great historical value.
